notes: Names are normalised before hashing (Unicode NFC, trimmed, lower case), for the body and the style alike: "nova", "Nova", "NOVA" and "nova " are the same avatar.
bb is the body bounding box measured with getBBox() in Chromium; the package should compute it analytically and match to 0.01.
style is the look "style from the name" gives; with styleFromName off the avatar wears none of it.
